mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_TRACKING_LOG_NO AS member_tracking_log_no, MEMBER_NO AS member_no, REQUESTED_PAGE AS requested_page, REQUEST_METHOD AS request_method, REQUEST_URL AS request_url, REQUEST_IP AS request_ip, ACCESSED_AT AS accessed_at FROM tb_member_tracking_log WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY ACCESSED_AT DESC
